## Projects

### externum
Programming language compiling the same source to Python, Bash and native binaries. Typed AST, ownership and traits, 192-test suite, browser REPL (Pyodide). Language: Python. License: MIT.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/externum

### talus-process-monitor
eBPF process/ransomware monitor for Linux. Kernel execve/openat tracing through Aya, per-CPU perf buffers, sliding-window behavioural alerts, FrankenTUI front end. Language: Rust. License: MIT.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/talus-process-monitor

### linux-aegis
Stackable Linux Security Module compiled in-tree against upstream. Four feature-flagged layers; CI applies patch set, builds and boots in QEMU on a minimal initramfs. Language: C. License: MIT.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/linux-aegis

### fortis
Bare-metal RISC-V chain-of-trust measuring boot integrity with real SHA-256 and ML-KEM-768 post-quantum primitives, no OS. Language: Rust. License: MIT.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/fortis

### quantum-shield
Post-quantum file encryption CLI. ML-KEM-768 KEM + HKDF + AES-256-GCM AEAD. NIST FIPS 203 oriented, fuzz-tested. Language: Rust. License: MIT.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/quantum-shield

### NV2_ENGINE
Rust voxel engine (wgpu) with MLP neural renderer for terrain/lighting approximation, multiplayer, ECS gameplay, content pipeline. Language: Rust.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/NV2_ENGINE

### Aurora
Operating system in the browser: kernel, window manager, filesystem, 8 apps, procedural audio, zero dependencies. Languages: Rust, TypeScript.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/Aurora

### TrustNode
Solana-style validator in Rust: Proof-of-History clock, Tower BFT, Sealevel parallel execution, Turbine erasure, CRDS gossip, JSON-RPC.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/TrustNode

### Meshcore
Serverless peer-to-peer chat over WebRTC data channels with MQTT signaling. Zero dependencies, npm package.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/Meshcore

### CyberForge
Four Rust security tools: port scanner, web scanner, hash cracker, packet analyzer. Tokio async, each published on crates.io.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/CyberForge

### Shortlink
URL shortener: FastAPI backend, JWT auth, click tracking, React dashboard, Docker.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/Shortlink

### Promptbox
Remote prompt inbox for AI agents: mobile-first, zero backend, GitHub Pages.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/Promptbox

### TeleWiedza
Bilingual PL/EN telecom encyclopedia: networking, 5G, fiber, security, certifications. Docusaurus.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/TeleWiedza

## Books

### The Stitcher Trilogy
A series of three dark literary horror novels about obsession, silk, and the thin line between art and madness: detective Marcus Delgado discovers a room full of dolls made from human skin and becomes obsessed with the craft of their creation.

#### The Stitcher (Book One, 2026)
A Chicago detective finds Mrs. Harlow surrounded by dolls sewn from human skin — and falls into the obsession herself. Slow-burn crime horror.
- ASIN: B0HHY39314 — https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HHY39314

#### The Curator (Book Two, 2026)
Pia Redfern inherits a museum collection of impossible, beating shells — and the curator who loves them too much.
- ASIN: B0HHXT2ZRZ — https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HHXT2ZRZ

#### The Reckoning (Book Three, 2026)
The thread fraying. The ending of the trilogy.
- ASIN: B0GX7CPY7H — https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GX7CPY7H

Site: https://bartoszosiej.github.io/thethreadcalls/
Genre: Dark literary horror / psychological thriller

## Series tagline
"The thread is fraying. Someone is cutting it."
